**Texere 0.4.4** · 11 November 2026

The setup does everything for you, one step at a time.

- **The Texere structure** (recommended): Texere sets up the folders, the bibliography and citation styles, the templates and writing guides, and **PDF++** (installed from Obsidian's official list and turned on). Each is its own step: you see what was done, then **Next**.
- **My own folders:** Texere's folders (reading notes, PDFs, export, bibliography) are created with your names; your other folders only if you tick them. PDF++ is installed too.
- **At the end**, the home page opens in a new tab and the Texere icon comes first in the ribbon.
- **Already using Texere?** After this update, if something Texere needs is missing (one of its folders, the bibliography, a template, PDF++), a short window adds it, one step at a time. Nothing of yours is moved or changed.

Also in this version (from 0.4.3, 0.4.2): citations work from the first start, no false folder alarms on a new vault, `@` citations forgive typos, no more stutter with the Zotero button on.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
